qs.q: A 5-year-old child undergoes multimodal treatment for a localized Wilms tumour. Which specific chemotherapeutic agents are included in the standard regimen?
qs.e: The standard chemotherapy for Wilms tumour includes vincristine and dactinomycin, with or without doxorubicin. Cisplatin and methotrexate are not primary components of this regimen.

qs.q: A 52-year-old man with chronic hepatitis C genotype 1 infection is being evaluated for initiation of antiviral therapy. Which standard regimen should be prescribed?
qs.e: Standard treatment for hepatitis C involves dual therapy with pegylated interferon-alpha and oral ribavirin. Monotherapy with agents like lamivudine or ribavirin alone is ineffective for clearing the virus.
